extension.summary: AB Tools - all-in-one Kodi maintenance and skin toolkit
extension.description: ABUKARIM TOOLS is an all-in-one utility for managing your Kodi setup. It bundles a Skin Installer and Skin Switcher, full backup and restore of your userdata, and quick access to the ABUKARIM Wizard and its maintenance tools (Total Clean and old thumbnail cleanup). A built-in patcher keeps popular add-ons (Seren, Prism, TinyPPI, Arctic Fuse 3, TMDbHelper, RedLight and more) working correctly on CoreELEC and Kodi, and re-applies its fixes automatically after those add-ons update. Also includes handy maintenance tools such as a speed test, a CPU benchmark and an add-on database rebuild.
extension.summary: أدوات أبوكريم - حزمة متكاملة لصيانة كودي وإدارة الواجهات
extension.description: أدوات أبوكريم هي أداة شاملة لإدارة نظام كودي لديك. تجمع بين مثبّت الواجهات ومبدّل الواجهات، والنسخ الاحتياطي الكامل لبيانات المستخدم واستعادتها، ووصولاً سريعاً إلى معالج أبوكريم وأدوات الصيانة فيه (التنظيف الشامل وحذف الصور المصغّرة القديمة). كما تتضمّن أداة ترقيع مدمجة تُبقي الإضافات الشائعة (Seren وTinyPPI وArctic Fuse 3 وTMDbHelper وRedLight وغيرها) تعمل بشكل صحيح على CoreELEC وكودي، وتعيد تطبيق إصلاحاتها تلقائياً بعد تحديث تلك الإضافات. وتشمل أيضاً أدوات صيانة مفيدة مثل اختبار السرعة واختبار أداء المعالج وإعادة بناء قاعدة بيانات الإضافات.
extension.news: v4.8.15 - Seek Preview faster on streams: pictures are made two at a time (three with More) while one more slot is kept for the spot you skip to, a 30-second grid is filled first, and each picture decodes faster. v4.8.14 - Seek Preview is accurate: the picture is the spot you skip to (a waiting card until it is ready, never a picture from minutes away), the whole picture is shown (no crop of wide films), and pictures are made around where you skip. v4.8.13 - Seek Preview: works on streams (pictures made 3 min each way, 10 with More), keeps trying after a failed picture, needs less free memory, and writes what it does to kodi.log. v4.8.12 - New: Toggles > Seek Preview - a picture of the spot you skip to above the seek bar (Lucent glass card, needs FFmpeg Tools; based on Seek Preview by easter478). v4.8.11 - New: Patching > Update TMDb Helper Players downloads the players pack and installs it in TMDb Helper (backup first, other players kept). v4.8.10 - TMDbHelper playback settings forced: Resolve library STRM only on, Dummy duration 0.5 s, Resolve delay 1.5 s. v4.8.9 - Fix: "Playback failed" no longer pops up when TMDbHelper plays through DexHub (or any non-resolvable player) with "Resolve library STRM only" on. v4.8.8 - AF3 repository link per Kodi version. v4.8.7 - New logo (gear / check icon) in the clearlogo and banner. v4.8.6 - Search All: bigger plot text; a source that does not play (or Back / Cancel on the add-on's searching / resume screen) returns to the results instead of ending the search - only Back in Search All closes it. v4.8.5 - POV and Red Light "Searching for streams" screens in the same Fen Light+ layout as Umbrella (info top left, status, percentage and full-width bar at the bottom). v4.8.4 - Umbrella "Searching for streams" screen in the Fen Light+ layout; Umbrella plays from Search All get plot / running time (OSD plot); Large plot no longer pushes the OSD ratings row onto the codec pills. v4.8.3 - Fix: Umbrella picks from Search All really play now (Umbrella 6.8 needs a plugin handle Search All does not have; the bridge plays through Kodi's player instead). v4.8.2 - Umbrella picks from Search All play again: a Fen Light+ style resume screen (Resume / Start Over / Cancel) asks first. Plot Text Size opens a selection (Large / Small); Large shows 3 plot lines on Home and in the OSD, and the OSD ratings row no longer covers the plot. Older versions: see changelog.txt.
